query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.open_id, u.role, u.created_at,
       au.id as app_user_id, au.name as app_name, au.email as app_email, au.token_balance
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN app_users au ON au.manus_user_id = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%מאור%' OR u.name LIKE '%Maor%' OR u.email LIKE '%maor%'
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC;
